unitTitle: Travel across the city and beyond
title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 9: Travel across the city and beyond

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the place, the person who has the information and the action to take next. Notice that lui/leur points to a person and y points to the named destination.

steps.title: A changed service notice
steps.body: Nadia and Karim read a fictional notice at a station.

examples.fr: Il y a une interruption de service sur la ligne bleue.
examples.en: Nadia: There is a service interruption on the blue line.

examples.fr: Je vais demander l'itinéraire à l'employée.
examples.en: Karim: I am going to ask the staff member for the route.

examples.fr: Tu lui demandes si l'arrêt provisoire est près d'ici ?
examples.en: Nadia: Will you ask her whether the temporary stop is near here?

examples.fr: Oui. Je lui demande aussi l'heure de départ.
examples.en: Karim: Yes. I will also ask her for the departure time.
Nadia: We are going to the community centre.

examples.fr: Nous y allons par la ligne express.
examples.en: Karim: Then we are going there by the express line.

examples.fr: Et si nous manquons la correspondance ?
examples.en: Nadia: And if we miss the connection?

examples.fr: Je vais demander une mise à jour à l'employée de la gare.
examples.en: Karim: I will ask the station employee for an update.

steps.title: Confirm the meeting point
steps.body: Karim confirms a landmark with Nadia before leaving.

examples.fr: La bibliothèque municipale est près du carrefour ?
examples.en: Karim: Is the public library near the intersection?

examples.fr: Oui, elle y est, en face de l'édifice public.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes, it is there, across from the public building.

examples.fr: Je vais donner l'adresse à Sam.
examples.en: Karim: I am going to give the address to Sam.

examples.fr: Tu lui donnes aussi le point de rencontre ?
examples.en: Nadia: Will you also give him the meeting point?

examples.fr: Oui. Je vais lui envoyer le plan.
examples.en: Karim: Yes. I am going to send him the map.

examples.fr: Nous allons au terminus, puis nous y prenons la ligne express.
examples.en: Nadia: We are going to the final stop, then we take the express line there.

examples.fr: Je vais expliquer le changement aux voyageurs.
examples.en: Karim: I am going to explain the change to the other travellers.

examples.fr: D'accord. Je leur indique l'entrée principale.
examples.en: Nadia: All right. I will point out the main entrance to them.

steps.prompt: What does Karim ask the staff member for?
steps.explain: He says he will ask about the route and departure time.

steps.prompt: Where are Nadia and Karim going?
steps.explain: Nadia names the community centre as their destination.

steps.prompt: What will Karim ask the staff for if they miss the connection?
steps.explain: He says he will ask them for an update at the station.

steps.prompt: What will Nadia point out to the other travellers?
steps.explain: She says she will indicate the main entrance.
